_comment: Example portfolio file for upkeep-mcp. Copy it to sites.json and edit.
sites.json and sites.local.json are gitignored — your real client list never gets committed.
defaults           Applied to every site; each site may override any of these.
sites              The portfolio. Every entry needs at least `name` and `url`.
name               Human label used in reports. Free text.
url                Full URL including scheme, the address a visitor would use.
domain             Registrable domain for registration and DNS checks.
Optional — derived from `url` when omitted. Set it when the
site lives on a subdomain and you want the parent checked.
checks             Which checks to run. Omit to use defaults.checks.
expiryWarningDays  Flag domain or certificate expiry within this many days.
tags               Free-form labels for filtering a report.
notes              Context for you; carried through into the report output.
Valid check names: domain, ssl, uptime, seo, accessibility.
The format is provisional until portfolio_report lands in Phase 3.

sites.name: Example Bakery
sites.notes: Smallest possible entry: everything else comes from defaults.
